Greek Small Letter Epsilon Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Greek Small Letter Epsilon is 238. Hold Alt, type 238 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Greek Small Letter Epsilon also has the Unicode codepoint U+03B5, so you can type it with Alt+949 on Windows, search for U+03B5 in macOS's Character Viewer, use ε in HTML, or \03B5 in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. Copy the Greek Small Letter Epsilon character from this page when you need it in a form, chat message or document that does not accept Alt codes. HTML also defines the named entity ε for Greek Small Letter Epsilon, but the numeric form ε is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type greek small letter epsilon on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 2 3 8 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Greek Small Letter Epsilon character (ε) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type greek small letter epsilon on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Greek Small Letter Epsilon. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Greek Small Letter Epsilon" and click the character to insert it.

How to use greek small letter epsilon in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\03B5"; ()
  • Python: \u03B5 or chr(0x3B5)
  • JavaScript: \u03B5 or String.fromCodePoint(0x3B5)
  • JSON: "\u03B5"
  • LaTeX: $\epsilon$ (math mode)

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Greek Small Letter Epsilon?

The legacy Alt code for Greek Small Letter Epsilon is 238. Hold Alt, type 2 3 8 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type ε without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ε, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+949 not work?

Alt+949 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Greek Small Letter Epsilon?

The Unicode codepoint for Greek Small Letter Epsilon is U+03B5. You can use this value in HTML as ε, in CSS as \03B5, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ε on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+03B5, then click it.
